input.subject: 16 Brindlewick Mews – kitchen ceiling leak
input.body:
Address: 16 Brindlewick Mews, Fenbarrow, ZZ1 1ZZ

Hi Iven,

Thank you for keeping the kitchen tap out of use and for leaving the hatch alone. The plumber has not opened the ceiling. The lining needs to be identified before anyone works near it, and we are now arranging this with your landlord. Please keep not using that tap and keep away from the hatch. If dripping starts again, the stain spreads, the ceiling sags, or water gets near any electrical fitting, let us know straight away. We will be in touch as soon as we have the next appointment to agree with you.

Kind regards
Northbridge Lettings

input.decision: Stage: work paused on site, with a landlord decision needed on a scope beyond the approved quote. The landlord approved only the quoted plumbing scope (event 013) and refused to fund a material assessment until she has the likely cost and timing (event 022). The repair cannot go ahead safely until the possible-asbestos lining is identified (events 017, 018, 023). The agency already asked her for a decision at event 024, so I have not written to her again. What she is missing is a specialist cost, which Mossbarrow Pipe Services cannot give (event 023). No asbestos specialist is named in the case, so I have handed the choice of surveyor to a human, with a P1 escalation to get the figures to the landlord quickly. I have recorded the landlord's decision. I sent the tenant a safety update: keep the tap out of use, stay away from the hatch, and report any new dripping. The case is held Waiting for Landlord until 16/06/2025. Urgency is P1, not P0: the leak is small and only happens when the tap is used, the tap is out of use, sockets are dry, there is no light under the patch and the ceiling is not sagging (events 003, 020). It is still a recurring leak waiting on a safety check, in a home with a young child. Rules: PM-AUTH-003, PM-AUTH-002, PM-SAFE-001.
